title: Tanvi, Isharani, Prannoy reach Vietnam Open semifinals
indian_angle: Multiple Indian players, including Tanvi Sharma, Isharani Baruah, and Prannoy, have advanced to the semifinals of the Vietnam Open.
summary: Indian shuttlers Tanvi Sharma, Isharani Baruah, and Prannoy secured their spots in the semifinals of the Vietnam Open. Tanvi defeated compatriot Malvika, while Isharani won her quarterfinal match against Huang Ching Ping.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, contributing to player development across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The new regulations will govern the upcoming Inter State Team Championships, a key domestic event for Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the official regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for the prestigious domestic tournament.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: A change in the women's doubles pairing for the World Junior Championships selection trials impacts India's junior representation.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced a change in a women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, affecting team composition.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This coaching camp at Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on junior player development.
